title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: AI Platforms Engineer
description:
Overview:

The AI Observability Engineer (Agentic Frameworks & AI Agent Operations Center Developer) builds and operationalizes agentic AI solutions using modern orchestration frameworks and contributes to an AI Agent Operations Center that enables safe, reliable, and observable agent behavior at scale. This role focuses on developing agent workflows (planning, tool execution, memory, and RAG), integrating guardrails and evaluations, and delivering operational capabilities such as run management, telemetry, and incident triage for production agents.

  
Responsibilities:

* **AI Agent Operations Center (70%)**
  + Build “operations center” capabilities for agent runtime management: agent registry, versioning, deployment tracking, and run histories
  + Enable operational workflows such as incident triage, replay/debug runs, trace correlation, and root-cause analysis across agent steps
  + Implement operational dashboards and views for agent health: success rate, latency, tool failure rate, cost per run, and loop detection
  + Instrument agent flows end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (or equivalent), enabling correlation across prompts, tool calls, retrieval, and responses
  + Implement semantic conventions and tagging standards (agent name/version, tool name, model provider, environment, tenant/app)
  + Partner with SRE/observability teams to ensure production-grade monitoring, alerting, and operational readiness
* **Collaboration with Teams (10%)**
  + Collaborate with transformation teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and tailor AI agents to specific domains.
  + Work closely with AI platform teams to build scalable and cross-domain AI agents while ensuring end-to-end observability.
* **Integration & Deployment (10%)**
  + Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for agent services and operations center components, including automated testing and deployment
  + Automate onboarding for new agent use cases (templates, scaffolding, configuration checks)
  + Drive best practices for secure, scalable, and cost-effective agent deployments
* **Continuous Learning (10%)**
  + Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies and integrate these into existing or new AI agents.
  + Conduct thorough testing and validation to ensure the reliability and accuracy of AI agents and solutions.

* Decision-Making Autonomy Moderate – Significant autonomy in the technical aspects of AI model development and implementation, working under the strategic direction provided by the Senior AI Solutions leads.
* Supervision Required Moderate – Operates with general guidance from the Senior AI Solutions leads, with regular updates for alignment and support.
* Complexity of Role High – The role requires managing complex AI/ML projects, working with large datasets, and ensuring successful integration with existing systems while maintaining scalability.
* Cross-Functional Interactions Yes – Regular interaction with Data Science, Engineering, IT, digital products and business stakeholders to ensure effective AI solution Observability.

  
Qualifications:

Key Skills/Experience Required Minimum Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 3–5+ years of software engineering experience; 1+ years building and observe AI/ML or GenAI applications preferred
* Required Expertise:
* + Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks (Crew.ai, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar)
  + Proficiency in Python (primary) and familiarity with APIs/microservices patterns
  + Strong experience with RAG patterns (embeddings, vector search, retrieval evaluation, chunking strategies)
  + Experience with cloud environments (Azure/AWS/GCP) and containerized deployments (Kubernetes/AKS/EKS)
  + Familiarity with observability fundamentals (logs/metrics/traces) and production troubleshooting
  + Experience building internal developer platforms or operational consoles (agent registry, run tracking, dashboards)
  + Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and telemetry pipelines
  + Experience with Azure AI Search / vector databases, prompt/version management, and evaluation frameworks
  + Knowledge of Responsible AI practices: data handling, safety guardrails, audit trails, and redaction strategies

FinOps exposure: token/GPU cost optimization and chargeback/showback reporting

Drentiating Competencies Required

* Technical Proficiency: Agent orchestration design (planning, tool execution, memory, RAG), Strong engineering discipline: testing, versioning, CI/CD, automation, Operational mindset: reliability, debuggability, and incident response support
* Problem-Solving: Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions.
* Collaboration Skills: Effective at working within cross-functional teams.
* Agility: Flexibility to adapt to changing requirements and new technologies.
* Communication Skills: Capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Principal Applied Scientist

**Overview**

  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.

  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.

* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.

title: Senior Associate - Data Science / Applied AI ML
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Drive \& Execute research and applied innovation in supervised/unsupervised/semi‑supervised learning, graph/network analytics, anomaly detection, and weak supervision to improve true\-positive rates, reduce false positives, and enhance investigator productivity.
* Develop and enhance detection models using supervised/unsupervised/semi\-supervised approaches (e.g., anomaly detection, clustering, weak supervision) and, where applicable, graph/network analytics to identify complex patterns and relationships.

* Apply GenAI/LLMs pragmatically (e.g., case narrative generation, unstructured text extraction/summarization) while prioritizing classical/statistical/graph ML methods where they deliver stronger, defensible detection efficacy.

* Master's degree (or PhD preferred) in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or related).
* Minimum 4 years of hands\-on AI/ML experience, preferably with exposure to financial crime compliance / conduct risk / AML / fraud / sanctions or similar control environments.
* Demonstrated experience building and/or deploying ML solutions (risk scoring, anomaly detection, triage/prioritization, NLP/LLM\-enablement) with a focus on measurable outcomes.
* Strong Python skills and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow) and common data/ML tooling.
* Practical knowledge of: imbalanced learning, cost\-sensitive evaluation, feature engineering, model calibration/threshold optimization, and performance measurement in detection settings.
* Working knowledge of MRM expectations (documentation, validation support, explainability, monitoring) in regulated financial services environments.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Summary**

We need a skilled Data Scientist to build and improve our time\-series forecasting models. You will analyse past data, spot trends, and create precise predictions for business growth, inventory, and demand. Your work will help our leaders make smart and fast choices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and scale robust time\-series forecasting models for demand, sales, and supply chain metrics.
* Clean, process, and analyse large volumes of historical data from multiple sources.
* Test new machine learning and statistical algorithms to boost model accuracy.
* Deploy models into production and track their performance over time.
* Work with product and business teams to turn data insights into clear plans.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience: 2 to 5 years of hands\-on data science experience with a focus on forecasting.**
* **Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.**
* **Programming: Strong coding skills in Python or R, SQL for data extraction.**
* **Modelling Tools: Deep knowledge of ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing, Prophet, and tree\-based machine learning models** (XGBoost, LightGBM). Deep learning experience (**LSTM/RNN**) is a plus.
* **Libraries: Proficiency in pandas, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, and MLflow or similar tracking tools.**
* Soft Skills: Good problem\-solving skills and the ability to explain complex data to non\-technical teams

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
